fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Save signature F1 A1 12 5F; the game ignores the save unless it is present
fields.evidence: set by the blank-save builder, checked by the loader; present in every bookmark

fields.name: bookmark_present
fields.meaning: 1 once a bookmark has been made; makes the title menu show the continue option with the cursor already on it
fields.evidence: set by the bookmark action, read when the title menu is built; blank-vs-bookmark comparison; reviewer-verified

fields.name: chapter
fields.meaning: Story chapter (script block 0-13) of the bookmarked page; the four title-menu stories start at chapters 0, 3, 9 and 12
fields.evidence: copied from the on-screen page snapshot by the bookmark action; reader: resume; writer: new-game chapter table

fields.name: scene
fields.meaning: Scene number inside the chapter of the bookmarked page
fields.evidence: copied from the on-screen page snapshot; differs between early and later bookmarks (0, 3, 4)

fields.name: text_speed
fields.meaning: Text speed option, 0-3 (0 fastest, 2 normal, 3 slow)
fields.evidence: bookmarks made after changing the setting show 1, 2 and 3; menu caps the value at 3; the text timer reads it

fields.name: one_hand_mode
fields.meaning: One-hand mode option: 0 = on, 1 = off (default 1)
fields.evidence: bookmarks made after toggling it show 0 and 1; menu caps the value at 1; the page-turn code reads it

fields.name: extra_menu_unlocked
fields.meaning: When 1 the title menu shows an extra selectable story item instead of a locked one
fields.evidence: title-menu builder reads it; a full-program search found no code that ever sets it; 0 in every bookmark

fields.name: reserved_00c
fields.meaning: Unused padding, 0 in every bookmark
fields.evidence: zeroed by the blank-save builder; a full-program search found no code referencing it

fields.name: check_group_00
fields.encoding: u16le sum of the 7 data words
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x00-0x0D
fields.evidence: recomputed over every bookmark

fields.name: background_picture
fields.meaning: Background photo shown at the bookmark (FFFF = none); redrawn on resume
fields.evidence: differs between bookmarks made in different scenes (0x56, 0xC9); saved on scene change, redrawn on resume

fields.name: picture_layer_1
fields.meaning: First extra picture layer at the bookmark: picture id (FFFF = none) plus a parameter
fields.evidence: saved on scene change, redrawn on resume

fields.name: picture_layer_2
fields.meaning: Second extra picture layer: picture id (FFFF = none) plus a parameter
fields.evidence: saved on scene change, redrawn on resume

fields.name: picture_layer_3
fields.meaning: Third extra picture layer: picture id (FFFF = none) plus a parameter
fields.evidence: saved on scene change, redrawn on resume

fields.name: check_group_01
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x10-0x1D
fields.evidence: recomputed

fields.name: story_vars_0_6
fields.meaning: Story variables 0-6 (counters/flags the script adds to, subtracts from, assigns and tests); cleared when a new story starts
fields.evidence: script variable operation with add/sub/set/compare; one variable changed 0->1 between two bookmarks made while reading on

fields.name: check_group_02
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x20-0x2D
fields.evidence: recomputed

fields.name: story_vars_7_13
fields.meaning: Story variables 7-13; cleared when a new story starts
fields.evidence: script variable operation; 0 in every bookmark

fields.name: check_group_03
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x30-0x3D
fields.evidence: recomputed

fields.name: story_vars_14_15
fields.meaning: Story variables 14-15; cleared at a new story; variable 15 is set from a slow system timer each time a story is started or resumed
fields.evidence: script variable operation; start/resume code copies the timer in; 0 in every bookmark (timer still 0 early on)

fields.name: story_vars_16_20
fields.meaning: Story variables 16-20; NOT cleared by a new story, so they carry over between playthroughs; variables 17, 18, 19 bias how variables 0-2 are tested in the first, second and third story
fields.evidence: the new-story clear range ends before them; the script test path reads them per chapter range; 0 in every bookmark

fields.name: check_group_04
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x40-0x4D
fields.evidence: recomputed

fields.name: resume_script
fields.meaning: Script routine to rerun when the bookmark is resumed (FFFF = none)
fields.evidence: saved on scene change, rerun on resume; FFFF in every bookmark

fields.name: text_delay_base
fields.meaning: Base character delay (always 3); combined with the text speed into the actual typing delay
fields.evidence: set to 3 whenever a story starts; the text timer multiplies/divides it by the speed; 3 in every bookmark

fields.name: bookmarked_once
fields.meaning: Set to 1 by every bookmark
fields.evidence: set by the bookmark action; blank-vs-bookmark comparison

fields.name: sprite_count
fields.meaning: Number of overlay/sprite records in use at the bookmark (0-8)
fields.evidence: saved on scene change; the resume code loops over this many; capped at 8; 0 in every bookmark

fields.name: reserved_056
fields.meaning: Unused padding, 0 in every bookmark
fields.evidence: zeroed by the blank-save builder; a full-program search found no code referencing it

fields.name: check_group_05
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x50-0x5D
fields.evidence: recomputed

fields.name: scene_history
fields.meaning: Read-back log of visited scenes, one byte per scene (14 data bytes per 16-byte group; the 2 check bytes of each group are skipped). The log is used to step back to earlier pages
fields.evidence: appended on every scene change, walked in both directions by the read-back code; grew 1 -> 5 -> 6 entries across bookmarks made while reading on

fields.name: history_tail
fields.meaning: Last 12 history bytes (entries 192-203); still zero in every bookmark seen
fields.evidence: same append/read-back code as the history

fields.name: history_length
fields.meaning: Write position in the scene history (raw bytes including skipped check slots)
fields.evidence: append/read-back code; 1, 5, then 6 across bookmarks

fields.name: check_group_12
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x120-0x12D (it only equals the history length while the history tail is zero)
fields.evidence: recomputed; the append code always skips this slot

fields.name: sprite_data
fields.encoding: u16le x4 per record, check words skipped
fields.meaning: Picture-overlay records, 4 words each (draw arguments: id, mode, position, flags); only the first sprite_count are live, the rest is leftover
fields.evidence: saved on scene change, each record passed to the picture routine on resume; leftover records present in one bookmark

fields.name: sprite_tail
fields.meaning: Last 4 overlay data words (record 7)
fields.evidence: same save/resume code as the overlay records

fields.name: reserved_178
fields.meaning: Unused trailing padding, 0 in every bookmark
fields.evidence: zeroed by the blank-save builder; a full-program search found no code referencing it

fields.name: check_group_17
fields.meaning: Check word for bytes 0x170-0x17D
fields.evidence: recomputed

fields.name: backup_copy
fields.meaning: Second, identical copy of bytes 0x000-0x17F with its own check words; read only when the first copy fails a check in bytes 0x000-0x14F
fields.evidence: the writer stores both copies; the loader restarts from the second one; copies are equal in every bookmark

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not used (zero in every bookmark)
fields.evidence: compared across bookmarks; the writer only covers 0x000-0x2FF

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The game does not use the console internal memory for its save
fields.evidence: identical from boot through every bookmark
